<parameter=sql>
WITH wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league.name as league_name,
        home_team as team_name,
        1 as wins
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE home_team_goal > away_team_goal
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        league.name as league_name,
        away_team as team_name,
        1 as wins
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE away_team_goal > home_team_goal
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_name,
        team_name,
        SUM(wins) as total_wins
    FROM wins
    GROUP BY league_name, team_name
)
SELECT league_name, team_name, total_wins
FROM team_wins
ORDER BY league_name, total_wins ASC
LIMIT 30
</parameter>
